outcome.summary: The Customer must pay a monthly fee of GBP 4,500, which is invoiced monthly in advance, with undisputed invoices due within 45 days of the invoice date [§2].
findings:
The Customer must pay a monthly fee of GBP 4,500, which is invoiced monthly in advance, with undisputed invoices due within 45 days of the invoice date [§2].

The relevant clause is [§2]:

> "The Customer shall pay the Supplier a fee of GBP 4,500 per month, invoiced monthly in advance. Undisputed invoices must be paid within 45 days of the invoice date."

[§2]

If an undisputed invoice is not paid by its due date, the Supplier is entitled to charge interest at a rate of 2% per month on the overdue amount [§3].

The relevant clause is [§3]:

> "If an undisputed invoice is not paid when due, the Supplier may charge interest at 2% per month on the overdue amount until it is paid."

[§3]

outcome.summary: The agreement can be ended through non-renewal notice at the end of a term or by written notice following an unremedied material breach.
findings:
The agreement can be ended through non-renewal notice at the end of a term or by written notice following an unremedied material breach.

### Non-renewal of the term
The agreement renews automatically for 12-month periods unless one party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term.

> "The agreement then renews for successive 12 month terms unless either party gives at least 90 days written notice of non-renewal before the end of the current term." (Source: [1])

[§4]

### Termination for material breach
Either party may terminate the agreement immediately upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach and does not remedy that breach within 21 days of receiving notice.

> "Either party may terminate this agreement immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within 21 days of receiving notice of the breach." (Source: [1])

[§5]

The Data Processing Addendum does not contain provisions regarding the methods for terminating the agreement; it only addresses obligations that occur once the services end (Source: [2], [§5]).
